task.title: To change the field-level locale, precision, and format for date and currency fields

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home icon() and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to the Work tab > Fields.
Click the Settings icon () adjacent the field name.
In the Field Settings page, based on the template field selected, you can view and change the following field properties:

ul.li: For date fields, you can change Locale and Date Format from their respective dropdown. The Date Formats displayed are based on the Locale selected.

For the currency fields, you can change the Currency Format, Currency Precision, and Locale from their respective dropdown.
Based on the locale selected, the default currency precision value provided in Conga CLM is displayed. You can change the Currency Precision value as per your requirement.

For the number fields, you can change the Locale and Number Precision from their respective dropdown.
Based on the locale selected, the default number precision value provided in Conga CLM is displayed. You can change the Number Precision value as per your requirement.
